tagline: Full-service interior design for homes that deserve more than a showroom.
style_suffix: warm minimalist luxury interior, cream, sand and walnut palette, soft late-afternoon light, Architectural Digest photography, wide angle, eye-level camera, photorealistic, 16:9, no people, no text

scenes.name: Plan
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Architectural floor plan sketch on cream paper, pencil lines, top-down.

copy.headline: It starts with *a plan.*
copy.body: Every project begins on paper: measured walls, the path of the light, how you move through a day.

scenes.name: Shell
scenes.keyframe_prompt: The same living room as an empty shell, bare plaster walls, concrete floor, tall windows.

copy.headline: Every room, drawn for *how you live.*
copy.body: We study the bones first: where the sun lands at four o'clock, which way the sofa should face.

scenes.name: Eye level
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Same empty room, eye-level wide shot.

scenes.name: Finishes
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Same room, oak floors and limewash walls added, still unfurnished.

copy.headline: Spaces that feel *like you.*
copy.body: Limewashed walls, white oak underfoot, and every piece chosen one at a time.

scenes.name: Living
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Same room fully styled: boucle curved sofa, travertine coffee table, sculptural lamp, linen curtains.

scenes.name: Doorway
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Doorway from the living room looking into the kitchen.

copy.headline: A kitchen made *for gathering.*
copy.body: Walnut cabinetry, a marble island and brass pendants that warm up at dusk.

scenes.name: Kitchen
scenes.keyframe_prompt: The kitchen: walnut cabinets, marble island, brass pendants.

scenes.name: Hallway
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Hallway leading to the primary bedroom.

copy.headline: Rest, *by design.*
copy.body: Linen bedding against a hand-troweled plaster wall. Nothing on the nightstand that doesn't need to be there.

scenes.name: Bedroom
scenes.keyframe_prompt: The primary bedroom, linen bedding, plaster headboard wall.

scenes.name: Bath
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Bathroom: travertine tub, arched mirror, zellige tile.

copy.headline: The *quiet* room.
copy.body: A travertine tub, an arched mirror, and handmade zellige that catches the last of the light.

scenes.name: Exterior
scenes.keyframe_prompt: Exterior view of the home at dusk, warm light glowing in the windows.

clips.motion_prompt: The drawing lifts and becomes a real 3D room, slow camera tilt.
Camera smoothly lowers from overhead to eye level.
Floors and walls finish themselves, camera slowly pushes in.
Furniture and decor appear piece by piece, slow orbit right.
Camera glides across the room toward the kitchen doorway.
Camera moves through the doorway into the kitchen.
Camera turns and drifts into the hallway.
Camera moves down the hall into the bedroom.
Camera pans through an arched doorway into the bathroom.
Camera pulls back through the window, out to the dusk exterior.

cta.headline: Let's design *yours.*
cta.body: Consultations last 60 minutes, at your home or by video. We'll reply within two business days.

footer.address: 48 Mercer Street, Studio 3, New York, NY
